No state meal-period requirement for adults in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.

Minors: under-16 weekly cap of 40 h is in La. R.S. 23:215(C); under-16 need a 30-minute meal interval in any 5-hour period (23:213, not encoded: no minor-break type). Extra param key max_days_week.
Minors: 16 and 17 night limits apply only before a school day; enforced every night of a school week (stricter).

rules.summary: When school is in session, minors under 16 may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on other days, 18 hours a week and 6 consecutive days, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: La. R.S. 23:214 — Minors under sixteen; maximum hours when school in session
citation.excerpt: shall not be employed, permitted, or suffered to work more than three hours each day on any day when school is in session, nor more than eighteen hours in any week when school is in session

rules.summary: Minors under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day, 6 consecutive days and 40 hours a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: La. R.S. 23:211 — Minors; maximum hours in general
citation.excerpt: No minor under the age of sixteen shall be employed ... more than eight hours in any one day, nor more than six consecutive days in any one week.

rules.summary: 16-year-olds who have not graduated may not work between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. before a school day.

citation.title: La. R.S. 23:215 — Minors; prohibited hours; maximum work week
citation.excerpt: No minor sixteen years of age who has not graduated from high school shall be employed ... between the hours of 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. prior to the start of any school day.

rules.summary: 17-year-olds who have not graduated may not work between midnight and 5 a.m. before a school day.

citation.title: La. R.S. 23:215 — Minors; prohibited hours; maximum work week
citation.excerpt: No minor seventeen years of age who has not graduated from high school shall be employed ... between the hours of 12:00 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. prior to the start of any school day.
